aboutLede: I build LLM applications. At DeepLearning.AI I am the founding and sole engineer on three AI recruiting products: an AI technical interviewer used in live hiring, a recruiter sourcing and review tool, and a candidate-facing career agent. Before that I built data and AI tools at Bexorg and Tassel, and flight-path analysis at NASA Ames.

roles.label: DeepLearning.AI
roles.title: Founding AI Engineer
bullets: Built the AI technical interviewer used in live hiring, with evidence-based grading that ties [[every skill score to a verified transcript quote]], so hiring managers can decide from the report alone.
Built and maintain the recruiter sourcing and review tool: migrated it from Railway to AWS with zero-downtime deploys, added bulk actions for 1,000 candidates, and cut LLM scoring costs.

Designed and built the Valence Career Agent, which helps candidates find their next role: it learns their goal, background and job constraints, runs a technical assessment, and returns a growth report with a positioning statement, answer coaching and a three-part growth plan.
Built a job-data pipeline tracking careers pages at 1,400+ companies, with 99,000+ jobs collected and 78,000+ live, to power role recommendations.

Exposed the sourcing tool as a scoped API for internal tools, and published [dlai-mcp-server](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dlai-mcp-server) on npm for searching DeepLearning.AI courses from Claude Code, Codex and Cursor.

roles.label: Tassel
roles.title: Full Stack AI Engineer
bullets: Built a video pipeline that segments graduation ceremony recordings by student and delivers personalized clips to [[2M+ students]], an $8M+ revenue opportunity.
Built a multi-agent transliteration chain on OpenAI that converts each student's name into its native-language script, so an ElevenLabs native voice pronounces it correctly in ceremony announcements.
Moved heavy Azure pipelines from always-on to on-demand scaling, cutting costs 40% and processing 8x faster.

roles.label: Bexorg

Built an ML quality-control system for time-series data with real-time anomaly detection, reducing data issues 70%.
Resolved critical pipeline bottlenecks, improving throughput 10x and enabling new enterprise customers.
